title: Woman On A Mission
notes: 10% of the profits of the album support the Women’s charity Womankind - Transforming the lives of Women & Girls Worldwide.

videos.title: Vibronics feat. Nia Songbird - 'All Sisters Unite'
videos.description: Vibronics and Cross Club Prague team up to bring you a new project that celebrates women in Reggae & Dub. “Woman On A Mission” is a new release featuring 8 female vocalists on 8 brand new Vibronics tracks. Each track's vocal track effortlessly glides
